Fish Planting Schedule

Page Info...

This dynamic Fish Planting Schedule is updated in real time, directly by CDFW Hatchery staff. Although it contains current information, all fish plants are subject to change depending on road, water, weather and operational conditions. Conditions permitting, the waters listed here will be restocked with catchable-size fish from CDFW hatcheries, according to this schedule. More specific dates are not given to avoid focusing excess fishing activity immediately after a plant.

If you have questions about Fish Planting activities, please call the Regional Office that covers the area in question.

See Fish Plants on a Map in our Fishing Guide

NOTE: The globe icon globe icon links and resulting map markers do not indicate the exact or only planting locations, but rather the general location of the waters being planted.

Page Instructions...

Range of dates available for viewing: the current week, one week in the future, and six months in the past.

On this page you may:
  • Sort any column in ascending or descending order by clicking its column heading
  • Focus your search for water name or county by using the "Search Criteria" link
  • Export your results to a spreadsheet using the "Export" button
  • Map any water location using the globe icon globe icon link
  • These search parameters can be saved as a bookmark/favorite on your browser. Use the appropiate method on your browser to do so (e.g. Press Ctrl+D (or Cmd+D on Mac) or find the appropiate menu option
Sign Up For Fish Plants Subscription
  • In order to suscribe, you must first login.
  • If you do not have CDFW account you must create one.
  • Next, after logging in go to My Subscriptions.
  • Check the box next to the Fish Plants subscription and once a week you'll receive a weekly list of current plants.
Search Fish Plant Results

All plants will be shown below unless search criteria has been chosen to limit results.
